The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2fa194c832cce8c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be the ring of integers in the unramified extension of Q5 of degree eight, and put A = V [x, y]/(5 + x4 + y4 )  (5,x,y) . Then A is a Noetherian regular local domain of dimension two and ker K5(A) −→ K5(Frac A)  ̸= 0. Consequently the unrestricted integral Gersten conjecture has a negative answer.
